title: Hello There
blurb: Say these two words in any room containing a Star Wars fan and somebody will answer GENERAL KENOBI before their brain has consulted them. Obi-Wan says it twice in the saga — cheerfully to R2-D2 in 1977, and to Grievous in Revenge of the Sith, which is the version the internet adopted. Prequel memes turned it into a password, a greeting and a personality test all at once, and it has stayed remarkably durable for a line that is, on paper, just a polite hello. Use it to open a chat and see who reveals themselves.
origin: Obi-Wan Kenobi's greeting from Revenge of the Sith, a prequel-meme cornerstone.
